summary_points: Employees get 18 days of annual leave
Remote work is allowed up to three days per week
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days
Laptops are replaced every three years
There is an annual learning budget of $1,500
The handbook includes site guides for individual sites

cases.question: How many days of annual leave do employees get?
cases.expected: 18 days per year, rising to 21 days after five years of service.

cases.question: If I don't use all my holiday, how much of it can I move into next year?
cases.expected: Up to 5 days can be carried over, and they must be taken by 31 March.

cases.question: How often are laptops replaced?
cases.expected: Every three years.
cases.evidence: Laptops are replaced every three years

cases.question: What is the deadline for submitting an expense claim?
cases.expected: Within 30 days of the cost being incurred.

cases.question: My work computer was stolen. How quickly do I need to tell IT?
cases.expected: Within 24 hours, by reporting it to the IT Service Desk.

cases.question: How much can I spend on training each year?
cases.expected: $1,500 per employee per year.

cases.question: What time does the canteen at the Johor site close?
cases.expected: 19:30 (it is open from 06:30 to 19:30).

cases.question: Who manages the Penang site?
cases.expected: Kelvin Ooi.

previous.question: How many days a week can I work remotely?
previous.answer: Up to three days per week, if your role allows it.

cases.question: Does that need anyone's approval?
cases.expected: Yes, it needs the agreement of your manager.
cases.evidence: with the agreement of their manager

cases.question: What is the policy on bringing pets into the office?
How much is the annual bonus?

summary_points: The agreement is between Harbourline Freight and Kestrel Analytics
The initial term is 24 months
The monthly fee is SGD 42,000
The platform must be available 99.5% of the time
Liability is capped at the fees paid in the preceding 12 months
The agreement is governed by Singapore law

cases.question: How long is the initial term of the agreement?
cases.expected: 24 months, starting on 1 March 2026.

cases.question: What are the payment terms?
cases.expected: Invoices are issued monthly in arrears and are payable within 45 days of the invoice date.
cases.evidence: within 45 days of the invoice date

cases.question: How much does the support component cost each month?
cases.expected: SGD 9,000 per month.

cases.question: What happens if the platform's uptime falls short of the target?
cases.expected: The customer gets a service credit of 5% of the monthly fee for each full 0.5% below the 99.5% target, capped at 20% of the monthly fee.

cases.question: How quickly does the supplier have to report a data breach?
cases.expected: Within 48 hours of becoming aware of the incident.

cases.question: Which country's law governs the agreement?
cases.expected: Singapore.
cases.evidence: governed by the laws of Singapore

previous.question: Can either party end the agreement early without a breach?
previous.answer: Yes. After the first 12 months either party may terminate for convenience.

cases.question: How much notice is needed for that?
cases.expected: 60 days' written notice.

cases.question: Who signed the agreement on behalf of Kestrel Analytics?

summary_points: The warehouse management system had an outage on 14 July 2026
The root cause was an expired TLS certificate on the message broker
The outage lasted 1 hour 55 minutes
1,240 shipments were delayed
Three distribution centres were affected
Actions include automating certificate renewal and adding expiry monitoring

cases.question: What caused the outage?
cases.expected: An expired TLS certificate on the internal message broker.
cases.evidence: expired TLS certificate on the internal message broker

cases.question: How long did the outage last?
cases.expected: 1 hour 55 minutes.

cases.question: How many shipments were delayed?
cases.expected: 1,240 shipments.

cases.question: Which sites were affected?
cases.expected: The Tuas, Johor and Batam distribution centres.

cases.question: Why wasn't the problem spotted before it caused a failure?
cases.expected: The renewal reminder went to the mailbox of an employee who had left, and monitoring did not check certificate expiry dates.
cases.evidence: mailbox of an employee who left

cases.question: How much was paid out to customers in credits?
At exactly what time did the broker's certificate expire?
cases.expected: At 02:07:31 Singapore time on 14 July 2026.

cases.question: What time was she paged?
Which certificate authority issued the certificate?

summary_points: The file contains about 4,000 orders
The orders are dated in 2025
There are four regions
There are five products
Each order has a status such as delivered, returned or cancelled

cases.question: How many orders are in the file?
cases.expected: The total number of orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data

cases.question: Which region has the most orders?
cases.expected: The region with the highest order count.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region FROM data GROUP BY region ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the total revenue, counting revenue as units times unit price?
cases.expected: Total revenue across all orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(units * unit_price), 2) FROM data

cases.question: How many orders were returned?
cases.expected: The number of orders with status Returned.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data WHERE status = 'Returned'

cases.question: Which product sold the most units?
cases.expected: The product with the highest total units.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product FROM data GROUP BY product ORDER BY SUM(units) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What was the average order value in December 2025?
cases.expected: The mean of units times unit price for December 2025 orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(units * unit_price), 2) FROM data WHERE order_date LIKE '2025-12-%'

previous.question: Is Reseller one of the sales channels?
previous.answer: Yes. The channels are Online, Reseller and Direct.

cases.question: How many orders came through it?
cases.expected: The number of orders in the Reseller channel.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data WHERE channel = 'Reseller'

cases.question: What was the profit margin on Carton Box?

summary_points: The workbook lists 300 employees
It has two sheets: employees and departments
It includes salary information
There are six departments
Each department has a budget and a head

cases.question: How many employees are there?
cases.expected: The total number of employees.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees

cases.question: Which department has the most employees?
cases.expected: The department with the highest headcount.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT department FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average salary in Engineering?
cases.expected: The mean salary of Engineering employees.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) FROM employees WHERE department = 'Engineering'

cases.question: Who heads the Finance department?
cases.expected: The head of Finance.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT head FROM departments WHERE department = 'Finance'

cases.question: Which department has the largest budget?
cases.expected: The department with the highest budget.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT department FROM departments ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the combined salary of everyone in departments whose budget is above 2 million?
cases.expected: Total salary for employees in departments with a budget over 2,000,000.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(e.salary) FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department = e.department WHERE d.budget > 2000000

previous.question: How many people work in Johor?
previous.answer: The number of employees located in Johor.

cases.question: And how many of those are in Operations?
cases.expected: The number of Operations employees located in Johor.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE location = 'Johor' AND department = 'Operations'

cases.question: What is the gender split of employees?

summary_points: The file contains 600 support tickets
Tickets have a category such as billing or delivery delay
Tickets have a priority level
Resolution time in hours is recorded
Customers have a tier such as Bronze, Silver or Gold

cases.question: How many tickets are there?
cases.expected: The total number of tickets.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data

cases.question: What is the most common ticket category?
cases.expected: The category with the most tickets.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category FROM data GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average resolution time for high-priority tickets?
cases.expected: Mean resolution hours for High priority tickets.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(resolution_hours), 2) FROM data WHERE priority = 'High'

cases.question: How many tickets came from Gold-tier customers?
cases.expected: The number of tickets from Gold tier customers.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data WHERE customer_tier = 'Gold'

cases.question: How many tickets ended with a satisfied customer?
cases.expected: The number of tickets where satisfied is true.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data WHERE satisfied = 1

previous.question: Which ticket categories are there?
previous.answer: Billing, Delivery delay, Damaged goods, Account access and API.

cases.question: Which of those takes longest to resolve on average?
cases.expected: The category with the highest mean resolution hours.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category FROM data GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(resolution_hours) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which support agent closed the most tickets?
